# compare_two_paths { #mofography.compute.compare_two_paths }

```python
compute.compare_two_paths(p1, p2, rag)
```

It takes two paths and a region adjacency graph, and returns a list of tuples, where each tuple
contains a node in the first path and a node in the second path

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                              | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| p1     |        | a list of tuples, each tuple is a coordinate in the path | _required_ |
| p2     |        | the path to be compared to p1                            | _required_ |
| rag    |        | the region adjacency graph                               | _required_ |
